Tool or resource page named by the toolkit

description: Digital Shoreline Analysis System is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS, United States Geological Survey. This downloadable software computes rate-of-change statistics from multiple historic shoreline positions. The software can compute rates of change for most any boundary change problem that incorporates a clearly-identified feature position at discrete times in a geographic information system. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Landslides, Wildfire. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
